Refreshed 2026-08-29 to the proton pin and CODATA 2022. Every cell is recomputed from alpha_em_form_comparison_probe.py and the canonical alpha_em_inv_derived, and the table is now internally consistent: 10.3635176 \times 11.8942752 = 123.266530. The previous cells were drifted and did not multiply out — they showed [9]_q[10]_q = 123.257 against their own product of 123.280 — and the correction row read -2.1\;\mathrm{ppm}, which is the Chern-Simons tower resummed with the Gram factor \kappa set to 1 (no Gram correction at all) at the muon pin (-2.128\;\mathrm{ppm}). The row above uses the derived Witten \kappa \approx 1.7216 with the tower resummed in closed form.

The correction remains conjectural. Only the bare row is derived. The Chern-Simons correction is a conjecture whose Gram constant \kappa is carried as an unproved Lean sorry; exact closure at this pin would need \kappa \approx 1.9153, which differs from the Witten value by 11.2\% (Chern-Simons correction, open problems).
